title: Residence permits, moving to Switzerland and naturalisation - MVP sources (federal and Canton Zurich)

scope.description: MVP scope: Swiss federal foundations for residence permits plus Canton of Zurich and City of Zurich entry points, extended on 15 September 2026 with the topics a newly arrived resident meets next (social insurance on arrival and departure, tax at source, the foreign driving licence, health insurance and premium reduction) and with naturalisation, at the same three levels. Other cantons are in the swiss-residence pack. Extended on 17 September 2026 with the contact pages of the Zurich offices these topics name: addresses, opening and telephone hours and directions where published. Extended again on 17 September 2026 with the daily-life duties of a newcomer in the City of Zurich: waste, parking and vehicles, dogs, school, taxes, the radio and television fee and emergencies. Extended on 18 September 2026 with voting rights and the Zurich tax-at-source tariff pages, and with the questions of expats settling in: family allowances and parental leave, housing and rent, customs on moving, marriage, pillar 3a, unemployment, accident insurance and leaving the City of Zurich.
exclusions: Tax tariff tables, premium and allowance calculators, individual amounts
Live data (timetables, vote results, current premiums)

planning_topics.label: Study, retirement and residence without employment
Settlement, renewal and changes of status
Health insurance on taking up residence
Tax and social insurance on taking up residence
Federal legal bases and administrative guidance

language_discovery.method: Later inspect html lang, hreflang and visible language navigation. Record declarations and detected section languages independently.
language_discovery.scope: New language URLs or hosts outside explicit allowlists require catalogue updates before crawling.
language_discovery.parallel_content: Independent snapshots, hashes, timestamps and source revisions; no equivalence from URL patterns alone.
language_discovery.selection_policy: Prefer a verified official German seed when choosing only one language version for a limited MVP run. Named scan sets and explicit --source selectors retain every selected language version, with German seeds scheduled first. Keep the recorded local language when no German equivalent has been verified; never guess translated URL slugs or silently fall back after a failed crawl.

build_notes: Only source references and operator-authored planning metadata are stored. No pages, quotations, legal claims, extracted topics/concepts, facts or rules are included.
Ready means eligible for a later test, not verified live, robots-approved, complete, authoritative on every linked topic or extraction-ready.
Robots, redirects, public-network checks and request/byte/time limits are enforced by SafeCrawler at run time. Query URLs remain disabled. Do not submit forms or log in.
Defaults scan the five smoke seeds only and do not make requests unless --crawl is supplied. Limits are per source and aggregate ceilings are printed in the plan.
Planning topic hints are for operator selection only. Do not feed them as expected concepts to source-first extraction or human annotation.
HTML content capture is opt-in at a later operator run. PDF documents and JavaScript-only applications need later adapters; record exclusions instead of claiming successful extraction.
Record requested/final URL, retrieval time, byte hash, content type, declared/detected language, source identity and jurisdiction with every later snapshot. Preserve municipal applicability.
Run the existing concepts CLI on saved pages. Cross-document topic clustering, review, supported operations and release publication remain later build stages.

German is preferred for single-version MVP seeds and crawl ordering. Multilingual selections retain all chosen official versions; candidate parallel page groups require later content alignment. Evidence selection is a planned separate policy and must not equate German preference with legal precedence.

Extension of 15 September 2026: the sources of the moving-to-Switzerland topics and naturalisation are registry seeds here and, with their subpages, explicit links in sources.md; the bounded downloader fetches every listed page at depth zero and follows no link. The scan sets smoke, federal, zurich and multilingual are the residence-topic sets of the rehearsal and are unchanged; moving and naturalisation select the extension; all selects everything. A run directory is bound to the catalogue bytes, so the extension needs a new run directory into which the saved pages of the rehearsal run are copied with their hashes before the new pages are downloaded.

Extension of 17 September 2026: the contact pages of the cantonal and city offices the pack names (Migration Office, Naturalisation Division, Road Traffic Office, Cantonal Tax Office, Office for the Economy, SVA Zurich, City of Zurich Population Office) are registry seeds in the scan set contacts and, with their subpages, explicit links in sources.md. The draft-3 catalogue needs a new run directory; the saved pages, Fedlex documents and text records of the draft-2 run are carried over with their hashes before the new pages are downloaded.

Extension of 17 September 2026 (daily life): the City of Zurich pages on first steps, waste, parking permits, dog control, public school, taxes and emergencies, the Canton of Zurich pages on dogs and on vehicles after a move, and the SERAFE pages on the household radio and television fee are registry seeds in the scan set daily-life and, with their subpages, explicit links in sources.md. The draft-4 catalogue needs a new run directory; the draft-3 run is carried over with its hashes before the new pages are downloaded.

Extension of 17 September 2026 (entry and visas): the SEM pages on entry with and without a visa, the 90-in-180-days stay rule, ETIAS, the Entry/Exit System, the Schengen area and the visa application, and the FDFA visa page are explicit links in sources.md, under the existing seeds ch-sem-entry and ch-sem-entry-faq and the new seed ch-eda-visa. The Canton of Zurich pages on family reunification by holders of an L permit and by recognised refugees are explicit links under the existing seed zh-family. The Ordinance on Entry and the Granting of Visas (VEV, SR 142.204) is the new legal-basis seed ch-fedlex-vev and is fetched through the Fedlex plugin like the other acts. The scan set entry selects these seeds. The draft-5 catalogue needs a new run directory; the draft-4 run is carried over with its hashes before the new pages are downloaded.

Extension of 18 September 2026 (voting rights and tax-at-source tariffs): the Federal Constitution (SR 101) and the Constitution of the Canton of Zurich (SR 131.211) are legal-basis seeds fetched through the Fedlex plugin; the Canton of Zurich page on who may vote and the ch.ch page on the right to vote are registry seeds; the Canton of Zurich tariff page and the calculation parameters of the current tax-at-source tariffs (PDF) are explicit links under the existing seed zh-tax-at-source, whose path allowlist gains the tax-at-source document folder. The tariff tables themselves stay out. The scan set voting-tax selects these seeds. The draft-6 catalogue is re-planned in place; saved pages, Fedlex documents and text records are kept.

Extension of 18 September 2026 (expat life): the Code of Obligations (SR 220) is a legal-basis seed fetched through the Fedlex plugin; ch.ch's pages on renting, marriage and the third pillar, the Federal Office for Housing's page on the reference interest rate, the Canton of Zurich's tenancy forms and unemployment pages, the City of Zurich's marriage and departure pages, the FSIO's pillar 3a FAQ, SECO's unemployment FAQ and the FOPH's accident-insurance pages are registry seeds, with their subpages as explicit links in sources.md. The family allowance, parental leave and customs sources of the earlier extensions join the scan set expat-life unchanged. The draft-7 catalogue is re-planned in place; saved pages, Fedlex documents and text records are kept.

Extension of 19 September 2026 (English versions): the English versions of the SEM, FOPH, FOCBS, SECO and SERAFE pages the release cites, and the German version of the SEM residence overview whose English version it cites, are explicit links in their own section of sources.md, without registry seeds. They were found through the German pages' declared language alternates and checked live; a fact cites the English passage next to the German one only after the two were compared. The SEM residence FAQ has no English version.

evidence_selection_policy.eligibility: Apply explicit scope, jurisdiction, applicability, effective date and source_languages filters before ranking evidence. Query and answer languages never imply a source-language filter.
evidence_selection_policy.ranking: Prefer authoritative, current evidence that supports the requested claim. German is only a final tie-breaker among verified equivalent, equally suitable official versions.
evidence_selection_policy.duplicate_support: Group verified equivalent sections of compatible source revisions when selecting evidence; translations of one source do not count as independent corroboration. Retain all source references and expose material differences or conflicts.
evidence_selection_policy.identity: Reviewed concept equivalence permits shared language-neutral concept IDs and multilingual term metadata. Documents, snapshots, sections, evidence IDs, URLs, source languages and hashes remain independently identified.
evidence_selection_policy.answer_language: The calling LLM chooses the answer language independently and cites the selected original evidence. Localized retrieval metadata is not factual evidence.
